item.title: Syracuse Department of Public Works faces CDL driver shortage during busy winter
item.description: The City of Syracuse is facing a shortage of commercial driver's license (CDL) drivers, which is putting extra pressure on crews during the busiest winter in years.

item.title: Shocked by your energy bill? You are not alone
item.description: National Grid customers in Central New York have seen their bills double in the span of a month due to increased supply costs of electricity and natural gas, which are affected by the colder-than-normal winter and aging infrastructure.

item.title: Syracuse's strays and city officials are running out of time
item.description: City officials in Syracuse are scrambling to find a temporary solution for the city's stray dogs after a shelter ended its contract with the city, leaving only one shelter bed available for the four strays turned in a week.

item.title: Patel Hotel Group member admits to grand larceny for owing taxes from 4 hotels in Onondaga County
item.description: Satish Patel pleaded guilty to attempted fourth-degree grand larceny for failing to turn over nearly $400,000 in room occupancy taxes to Onondaga County, and was given a one-year conditional discharge if the funds are repaid.
